Eiljah.title: Elijah
Eiljah.question: Can zeal mature into listening, mercy, and faithful succession?

chapters.title: The Drought
chapters.game: Follow ravens to daily bread by the brook.

chapters.title: The Widow’s Jar
chapters.game: Measure flour and oil without exhausting either.

chapters.title: The Child Restored
chapters.game: Carry the child upstairs and persist in prayer.

chapters.title: Mount Carmel
chapters.game: Repair the altar with twelve stones.

chapters.title: The Rain Returns
chapters.game: Spot the small cloud and race from the storm.

chapters.title: Under the Broom Tree
chapters.game: Rest, eat, and accept care before travelling.

chapters.title: The Quiet Voice
chapters.game: Distinguish wind, quake, fire, and quiet.

chapters.title: Naboth’s Vineyard
chapters.game: Expose the false testimony behind the seizure.

chapters.title: Chariots of Fire
chapters.game: Cross the Jordan and pass the mantle to Elisha.
